content.short: OpenOcean is a full aggregation protocol sourcing liquidity from 1000+ DEXes and market makers across 30+ chains for the best swap execution.
content.description: OpenOcean is a comprehensive DEX aggregation protocol sourcing liquidity from over 1,000 on-chain exchanges and market makers across 30+ blockchains, using an intelligent routing algorithm that splits trades optimally to minimize price impact and gas costs. The platform also supports limit orders, cross-chain swaps, and DCA strategies for automated trading. OpenOcean has been operating since 2020 and is fully deployed on Mantle, providing access to best-in-class swap execution for the network's users.
content.meta: OpenOcean aggregates 1000+ liquidity sources for the best DEX swap prices on Mantle and 30+ chains. Discover OpenOcean on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
